title: Climate Investment Funds (CIF)
definition: The Climate Investment Funds (CIF) are a set of multilateral climate funds established in 2008 to provide developing countries with scaled-up financing to initiate transformational change towards low-carbon and climate-resilient development.
importanceInUpsc: CIF is a critical component of Climate Finance, frequently appearing in Prelims regarding international climate architecture and in Mains for GS Paper III (Environment/Economy) regarding climate justice and global funding mechanisms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Climate Investment Fund.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
